limits: Versions and pinned recipe files match; prebuilt debs do not record build commits. This is not bit-identical rebuild evidence.
libc++ recipe copies NDK binaries: an NDK zip is not libc++ source. Android source provenance must be bundled separately.
Ncurses auxiliary terminal definitions are not copied into APK; current referenced versions are recorded separately from the library source.
Host build prerequisites and full optional Rust/Mesa sources are tracked by separate graphics manifests.
